capabilities: Sync the whole vault to GitHub or Gitee over git (commit, pull, push, scheduled sync)
Mirror vault images to Cloudflare R2 with a filterable image manager
Install, update, roll back and freeze community plugins and themes from GitHub or Gitee
Show diffs, sync status, conflict guides and repository cleanup in a sidebar panel
Check for and apply updates to SyncHub itself
extras: Not in the official community plugin store; manual installation required. The manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Vault sync is desktop-only (needs system git); plugin installation works on mobile. Tokens are stored in the OS keychain, not data.json. The author accepts donations via PayPal and a coffee QR code.
motivation: The author found obsidian-git mature but limited to GitHub and GitLab, and BRAT GitHub-only and dependent on releases, so SyncHub adds Gitee support, source-file installs, and backup-before-write installation.
problem: Existing git-sync and beta-plugin tools for Obsidian only support GitHub and GitLab, leaving Gitee users without vault sync or plugin installation.

relations.evidence: obsidian-git is mature, but it only knows GitHub and GitLab
obsidian42-brat is also GitHub-only, and requires the plugin to have published a release

keeps a copy of your vault's images on Cloudflare R2

summary: Git-based vault sync to GitHub or Gitee, plus Cloudflare R2 image backup and a plugin/theme installer that works with both platforms.
